Mission event timeline

DATA INTEGRITY · This is a replay of an explicitly hypothetical, two-dimensional numerical propulsion model — not evidence of a real antigravity drive. The untouched RC42 archive is the source of all recorded transfer samples and issued commands. Long unpowered coast states have been thinned for mobile playback; powered departure/capture samples are retained. Stage 0 departure orbits and post-shutdown verification orbits are additional visualizations derived from the archived initial/final states and audit windows so the mission replay is easier to understand and share.

About this Mission Control view

This static website packages successful Gravity Aperture Drive benchmark evidence into a shareable “mission control” replay.

  • Recorded data: transfer states, controller stages, aperture commands, and navigation decisions come directly from the successful RC42 benchmark evidence.
  • Derived views: a stable departure orbit (Stage 0) and a post-shutdown verification orbit are added so viewers can see a complete mission story around the recorded transfer.
  • Aperture aim panel: the θ/φ values are converted into an intuitive body-centered aim-point indicator.
  • Current missions: Earth → Mercury, Mars → Mercury, Jupiter → Neptune, and Saturn → Neptune.
